CA.rationale: Candidate entry pairs a processing-origin kind (command_estimate) with the same content red positions, linking processing condition to content presentation.

COD.rationale: The report explicitly names content (red positions) and separately gives organization/access metadata (origin) for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing-origin (command_estimate) is explicitly tied to the same candidate content entry, constituting a processing/attention relation.

C.rationale: The text identifies explicit content entries (red/blue positions) for named referents.

D.rationale: Content (red positions) is given and separately attributed an origin/representation status, distinguishing identification from organization/access metadata.

O.rationale: Origin/represented_time metadata describe how the content is represented/accessed (organization/presentation) for the named referent.
